text: In the small Oregon town of Cispus Falls, the teacher Julia Meadows notices that twelve-year-old Lucas Weaver makes [frightening drawings|images|pictures, screens and recordings] and roams the town collecting roadkill. Haunted by her own father's abuse, she suspects [the boy is being hurt at home|wrong|cruelty at home]. Behind a locked attic door in his rundown house, Lucas is feeding the carcasses to [his ravenous father and little brother|who_suffers|families and parents], who were attacked by [an unseen creature|threat|monsters and creatures] in the inactive mine where Frank cooked meth.
